sections.content:
1. we can gradually improve our standard packages, when we find one duplicates in the same repo we can refine the packages to align. lets use challenges, and migrate the essays.

sections.content: The owner, in conversation with Claude Code, 2026-11-11, answering the three questions of the B2 plan on srs-web#694: (1) one 'argues against' relation, where the site uses `challenges` and the essay editor `com.mudemocracy.essay/counters`; (2) sentence-level backing; (3) converting the 31 old `projects` links.
